b1-pure-j: Just the six lit cells. Boldest at 16 px.
b2-patched-route: Cells fuse into one J; the blue jack at the top is where it plugs in.
b3-open-sockets: Empty cells are open sockets, ready for the next skill or MCP server.
b4-quiet-field: The whole field stays visible in a quiet grey; only the J is lit.
b5-soft-j: The same cells with the bowl's outer corners rounded, so it reads as a letter first.
b7-quiet-soft-j: B4 and B5 together: the soft J, lit inside a quiet field.
b6-panel-j: The field becomes a faceplate and the J is lit through it. App-icon ready.
